provenance.note: Table III-B, Area irrigated by different sources, pages 125-131 of the DES Season and Crop Report 2024-25 (PDF sha256 49bbd356b1aab315a53e9a62ef0ba9a124a90c5975231146fb1bab0498f7eb75, Google Drive file 1uONHRwuvU9-EhDGD1v0XC0OWqAVOZtV6 from the DES listing): the Tirupathur row (Sl. No. 10), net area irrigated per source with the report's printed net total, gross total, area irrigated more than once and irrigation intensity, read into a reviewed extraction (pipeline-inputs/atlas/tn/tirupathur/irrigation-des.json) and validated here. Supplementary wells water land already counted under another source and are recorded separately, never added to the net total.

conventions.units: hectares, whole, as the report prints them; shares in percent of the printed net total, one decimal
conventions.edition: 2024-25 is the report's agricultural year, not a publication date
conventions.supplementary_wells: not a component of the net total; they supplement land under other sources
conventions.rounding: component sums may miss the printed net total by up to 2 ha of the report's own rounding; the printed total is served

supplementaryWells.note: The report's supplementary-wells column ('by all other types of wells') records 0 ha net for this district in 2024-25.

notes: The two well components sum exactly to the printed net total of 30341 ha; canals, tanks and other sources are all printed as 0, so every irrigated hectare in the district is watered from a well.
The report's percentage table prints 0.00% for canals and tanks against the same 30341 ha net total.
